ideas.title: Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: An investigation into the prevalence of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota, including the recent charges against 7 providers
questions: What is the extent of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
How are state and federal authorities working to prevent Medicaid fraud?
ideas.insight: I believe that Medicaid fraud is a significant issue in Minnesota, and that a thorough investigation could uncover more instances of fraud. By analyzing data and public records, we could identify patterns and connections between entities that could lead to further charges and convictions.
